trap-nonspeakable.notes: SEPARATE (non-trap) findings. (1) SELF-CONTRADICTION in the closing section. Immediately after displaying m(K) approx rho_q . [2 pi lim_{N->infinity} log|J_N(K; e^{2 pi i/N})| / N], the text says 'No continuous inputs remain' and 'avoiding the N -> infinity continuum idealization entirely'. The displayed formula IS an N -> infinity limit and contains 2 pi; both claims are refuted by the equation three lines above them. FIX: say what is actually meant - that the framework's own evaluation is the finite Hecke trace at q_0, and the Kashaev limit is invoked only to identify what that trace computes. (2) RECOMPUTED and CORRECT: rho_q := 1/hbar_q^2 = q^2/(q-1)^2, since hbar_q = 1 - 1/q = (q-1)/q. 'q_0 approx 1.11' is a legitimate 3-s.f. rounding, not the banned 1.1097. (3) SECTION 4d: the block opens with a prose '> **Superseded.**' banner; per AGENTS.md section 4d that is author-tracking metadata and belongs in authorNotes as kind 'deprecated' with a 'see' link. The .ts carries no authorNotes at all. Same defect in the sibling conj:kashaev-volume-conjecture.md. (4) The topological mass formula is written m(K) = Vol(K)/hbar_q^2, without the m_e factor the AGENTS.md canonical form m(K) = m_e . Vol(K) . rho(K) / hbar_q^2 requires; the Superseded banner covers this, but the expression as printed carries no mass unit.
